method: corrected_return = (close + cash_distribution) / close_prev - 1, using unscaled exchange closes
sources: Closes 2021-12-29 and 2021-12-30: MarketWatch XIC historical quotes (countryCode=ca), viewed 2026-11-07. Cash distribution: Yahoo Finance XIC.TO dividend record (quantmod::getDividends, split.adjust=FALSE), retrieved 2026-11-07. Cross-check: S&P/TSX Composite (^GSPTSE) -0.235% that day.
rationale: Yahoo encodes iShares' reinvested (non-cash) 2021 year-end distribution as a 1.013171 split and scales all earlier XIC prices up by that factor (e.g. 2020-01-03: Yahoo 27.487 vs MarketWatch 27.13 = 27.13 x 1.013171). This leaves other daily returns unchanged but turns 2021-12-30 into -1.436% instead of about -0.129%. See tests/adjustment_checks.md.
status: applied in main specification; uncorrected result kept as sensitivity
